name: Raffles Makkah Palace

address.street: King Abdul Aziz Endowment Oum Al Qura Street Mecca

insider_take: Standing just steps from Islam's holiest site, this ultra-luxury sanctuary offers pilgrims an unparalleled blend of spiritual devotion and five-star refinement in the heart of Mecca.
whats_special: Direct views of the Holy Kaaba from select rooms and suites, making it one of the closest luxury hotels to the Grand Mosque. The property features traditional Islamic architecture with contemporary French elegance, plus dedicated prayer facilities and halal dining options throughout.
pro_tip: Book a Kaaba-view room well in advance, especially during Hajj and Umrah seasons. The hotel offers complimentary shuttle service to the Grand Mosque entrance, saving valuable time during peak pilgrimage periods.
dont_miss: The rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Sacred Mosque and Mecca's skyline, and the hotel's signature afternoon tea service featuring Middle Eastern delicacies with a French twist - a unique cultural fusion you won't find elsewhere in the holy city.
pros: Prime location with direct access to Masjid al-Haram
Ultra-luxury accommodations with exceptional service standards
Premium dining options and world-class amenities
Sophisticated design blending modern luxury with Islamic heritage
cons: Located in extremely busy pilgrimage area during Hajj season
